pages.title: §lMaterial Categories
pages.text: Enchanting materials are divided into two categories:$(br2)§l1. Universal Materials§r$(br)Such as §bNether Stars§r and §bDiamonds§r. They don't target specific affixes but boost overall tier probabilities.$(br2)§l2. Directed Materials§r$(br)Such as §bBlaze Rods§r and §bPoisonous Potatoes§r. They greatly increase the weight and tier of specific affixes.

pages.title: §bNether Star §r- Universal
pages.text: §bNether Stars§r are the strongest universal material, providing +60% tier weight bonus and accumulating 2 pity points per roll.

Materials also have multiple tiers:$(br)§7Tier 1§r: Coal, Flint$(br)§7Tier 2§r: Iron Ingot, Copper Ingot$(br)§7Tier 3§r: Diamond, Emerald$(br)§7Tier 4§r: Netherite Ingot, Nether Star$(br)§7Tier 5§r: Dragon's Breath$(br2)Higher tiers provide stronger bonus.
